title: Chhanni managed policy
description: Organisation policy for Chhanni, delivered through the browser's own enterprise policy channel (Windows GPO, macOS profiles, Chrome Enterprise, Firefox policies.json). No network request is involved: the browser hands these values to the extension locally, which is why this feature exists at all.

mode.title: Interruption level
mode.description: strict stops for everything found; warn stops for credentials and identifiers; off disables detection.

lockMode.title: Prevent users changing the interruption level

requiredDetectors.title: Detectors that cannot be switched off
requiredDetectors.description: Rule ids, as printed by `chhanni rules`.

allow.title: Values never flagged
allow.description: Shared test fixtures and sample keys that appear in internal documentation.

codenames.title: Internal project codenames
codenames.description: Words that should be treated as confidential when they appear in a prompt. Nothing leaves the device; this list is matched locally.

watchResponses.title: Inspect assistant replies as well as prompts

message.title: Message shown in settings
message.description: One line explaining the policy, e.g. who to contact about it.
